notes.title: Patch Update!
notes.content:
Fixes for 3/25/18

*Neighborhood kids have smoother animations with cleaner transitions
*Now easier to make minions on hills
*fixed bug where the pointer for directing minions appeared sometimes when there were no minions.
*stats screen visual update
*wave number now present
*the bounding box shadows no longer appear around the hands
*icon swap on the first tutorial
*fewer occurrences of neighborhood kids getting stuck

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
Thanks for trying out my game!  I'm Evie!  The primary dev on the project.  There will be others in and out of the project, adding cool stuff like art, music, sound FX and other goodies, but I'm here to stay =P

What you have before you is Waves 1 - 6 of Arcade Mode of Epic Snowday Adventure.  The plan is to keep making arcade mode for awhile, adding seasonal specials, tournaments, multiplayer, and much more.  Then I begin phase 2.... What is phase 2?  You can only imagine what phase 2 is... but its going to be EPIC!  It also wont be around before Q2 2019, but hopefully you won't lose interest before then!

Now, on to updates!  You can count on at least one update per month, but I may surprise you here and there with updates outside of that schedule... like the one I just submitted today!  This one is some simple bug fixes, where I had some players teleporting INTO houses.  You're not supposed to be able to do that!  ... yet!  

Bug Fixes:
[list] 
[*]Fixed teleport into house on wave 4
[*]Unreachable hidden cocoa now possible to consume
[*]Took out some unnecessary lighting calculations, which should make the game run a bit faster on slower computers!
[/list]

We're a small team so sometimes weirdness slips through the cracks, but I'll be around fixing stuff.  I enjoy it... really.  So let me know if there's stuff you wanna see.  And look forward to April's update which should reach you guys mid April or sooner.    April's update will have a few new features but the primary one is Avie "the ninja" Jones.  Stay tuned!  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32169445/48b53cd965a1aaa349113fcba0d5562a77c38ae5.gif[/img]

If you wanna stay EVEN MORE in the know and potentially be invited into beta testing, follow us in the community hub!  We really appreciate having more people test our game before it hits the masses.
